dmn_experiences.title: Sheffield Craft Beer Experience
dmn_experiences.summary: A guided tour of three of Sheffield's craft beer venues with tutored tastings and a brewery tour, led by an expert local guide. It finishes at Triple Point Brewery.
highlights: Brewery tour and tutored tastings at each stop
Venues including the Rutland Arms and Lost Industry Taproom
Led by a knowledgeable local guide

dmn_experiences.title: Sheffield Craft Beer Tasting Experience - Sheffield Brewery Tours (Private Groups)
dmn_experiences.summary: A private-group craft beer walking tour visiting three specially selected Sheffield venues over 2.5 hours, sampling styles from pale ales to stouts with an expert guide. Start times can be tailored to the group.
highlights: Three craft beer venues with tastings at each
Range of styles from pale ales to stouts and porters
Expert local guide on beer and brewing history
Private groups with flexible start times

dmn_experiences.title: Triple Point Brewery Tour
dmn_experiences.summary: A guided tour of Triple Point Brewery in Sheffield with a Q&A with the head brewer and a tasting of four brewer-selected beers. All the beers are vegan and gluten-free.
highlights: Guided tour of the production facility
10% off additional drinks, food and merchandise
